Occurrences.Kwic: 下禪宗碩學，咸會京師。天使歸朝，足可咨决。貧道隈山傍水，無所用心。光庭泣拜。師曰：休禮貧道。天使為求佛耶？問道耶？曰：弟子智識昏昧，未審佛之與道，其義云何？師曰：若欲求佛，即心是佛。若欲會道，無心是道。曰：云何即心是佛？師曰：佛因心悟，心以佛彰。若悟無心，佛亦不有。曰：云何無心是道？師曰：道本無心，無心名道。若了無心，無心即道。光庭作禮信受。既回闕庭，具以山中所遇奏聞。即勅光庭詔師到京，勅
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (五燈全書(第1卷-第33卷)): Sikong Benjing utters the exact headword wording after complete-case review.

ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: No-mind being the Way is Benjing’s compact public answer to an envoy asking how the Way is understood.
EvidenceBody: Benjing immediately glosses his answer: the Way originally has no mind; “mind” and “Way” are provisional names, and when mind is exhausted there is nothing on which a Way could stand. Five witnesses transmit that one court-tested exchange; Huanyou later raises the formula and relocates its test in ordinary acts.
